maddeler.e:
عزوا (form I)
# عَزُّوا (ʕazzū) /ʕaz.zuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of عَزَّ (ʕazza)
# عُزُّوا (ʕuzzū) /ʕuz.zuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of عَزَّ (ʕazza)
# عِزُّوا (ʕizzū) /ʕiz.zuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of عَزَّ (ʕazza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
